text:
maria: Quick sync re: Cross-marketplace parity for the Zenith private-offer. Partner insists identical net economics across AWS/GCP/Azure listings. Risk: exchange rate + marketplace fees make exact parity impossible. Proposal: publish headline %s per-region and add a note: 'Net incentives shown after local marketplace fees' with local currency examples. Thoughts?
devon: Agree we can't promise exact parity. Suggest publish a reference USD headline and then show region-specific examples (EUR/GBP/JPY) with a small conversion disclaimer. Keeps transparency.
hao: Ops/billing: mechanically easier to keep offer_id same but include `marketplace_fee_adjustment` line in billing pipeline. We'll emit billing events like: {event_type:credit_adjust,offer:ZENITH-PVT,marketplace:AWS,adjust_usd:-1200} for audit, but we'll keep that internal and not show raw numbers in listing.
prit: Sales: Field wants a single predictable number to pitch. If we show region examples, include an 'approx. net saving' per band and a CTA: 'contact sales for exact quote'. That reduces surprises.
ops-bot: Reminder: checklist incomplete: legal parity disclaimer, billing mapping for marketplace fees, marketing copy, AE one-pager.
maria: OK action items: (1) Hao: implement billing tag `marketplace_fee_adjustment` + sample event schema (2) Devon: draft listing copy with USD headline + regional examples (3) Prit: AE one-pager with sample math and CTA (4) Maria: legal to review parity disclaimer.
devon: I'll draft copy today and include an example for EUR at current mid-market rate, plus a short line: 'Actual charges subject to marketplace billing and FX at invoice time.'
hao: Will open billing PR with `applied_auto:true|false` flag and marketplace tag so ops can reconcile.
prit: Field happy with CTA approach.
maria: If no objections, we lock wording and publish regional examples behind the 'pricing details' accordion.
ops-bot: Thread archived to #partnerships  thread 4912345670.
